supported_claims: minimal_variance is advertised but the pinned _identify branch raises NotImplementedError; exclude this operation at this pin.

BaseGraphicalIdentification validates type and role presence; role validation does not check causal admissibility. Adjustment._validate checks parents of exposures. With root X in X->M->Y it returns all(empty)=True even when adjustment={M}. Add independent descendant and strict backdoor checks for the proposed total-effect path. This is a static source trace, not an installed-engine result.

DAG.minimal_dseparator greedily deletes dispensable variables. Do not promise globally minimum cardinality or variance based on the word minimal or the docstring smallest. Multiple inclusion-minimal sets can have different sizes.

PC pdag/cpdag return the same partially directed object; dag calls to_dag. PDAG.to_dag may warn and orient arbitrarily if consistent extension fails. to_cpdag calls this conversion. Never use conversion alone to certify valid equivalence-class semantics.

The all branch enumerates subsets of an ancestor candidate set after causal-path/latent exclusions. Its completeness domain differs from every observed-variable subset; it is exponential and does not license unrestricted targets.

LLMPairwise uses variable descriptions, not data values, and has an optional provider path. It is a distinct information source from CI-based PC and remains outside the selected non-network graph service.
